summary: A permitted cross-origin redirect must withhold credential-like headers, including custom names such as X-API-Key, not only Authorization.
reason: Go's redirect policy strips Authorization and Cookie on a foreign host but copies other headers. An allowed off-origin hop would otherwise deliver operator-configured credentials to that host.
validated_outcome: CheckRedirect drops Authorization, X-API-Key, and X-Auth-Token on a foreign https host and keeps them on a same-origin hop.
